title: RnaAlphabet
description: IUPAC nucleotide codes for RNA: A/C/G/U plus the standard ambiguity codes (R,Y,S,W,K,M,B,D,H,V,N). 'T' is deliberately excluded (that's DnaAlphabet). Also allows '-' and '.' as alignment gap/missing-data characters, since a Sequence doubles as an alignment row. Case-insensitive.
